Features
 
Everything you need to book a great pro
 

Geeb is built around the moments that matter: finding someone you trust, knowing the price, and knowing the job is done right. Here is how every layer of the platform works in your favour.

 
 
  
 
 
   01  
Verified service pros
 
Every pro on Geeb is background-checked, ID-verified, and reviewed by real customers. We confirm trade qualifications, run reference checks, and continuously monitor ratings so you hire with confidence.
 
     
  •   Government-issued ID verification 
  •   Trade & certification checks where applicable 
  •   Ongoing rating & review monitoring 
  •   Insurance documentation stored securely 
    •  
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
Verified service pros screenshot
 
Drop image or GIF here
 
 
  
 
 
   02  
Instant booking, real-time availability
 
See live availability from pros in your service area, compare profiles, and lock in a time in under a minute. Same-day service for urgent jobs — plumbing leaks, electrical faults, and lockouts do not wait.
 
     
  •   Live availability by service area 
  •   Same-day booking for urgent jobs 
  •   Auto-rescheduling on conflicts 
  •   Calendar sync with your phone 
    •  
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
Instant booking, real-time availability screenshot
 
Drop image or GIF here
 
 
  
 
 
   03  
Transparent pricing — no surprises
 
See upfront quotes, hourly rates, and material costs before you confirm a booking. Pros submit itemized estimates; you approve or request changes. No haggling, no hidden fees, no awkward conversations.
 
     
  •   Upfront, itemized quotes 
  •   Hourly or fixed-price options 
  •   Material cost transparency 
  •   No charges until the job is done 
    •  
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
Transparent pricing — no surprises screenshot
 
Drop image or GIF here
 
 
  
 
 
   04  
Real-time tracking from dispatch to done
 
Follow your pro from assignment to arrival on the in-app map. Live ETAs, status updates, and in-app chat keep everyone in sync throughout the job. You always know who is on the way and when.
 
     
  •   Live map tracking from dispatch to arrival 
  •   In-app chat with your pro 
  •   Push-notification status updates 
  •   Job-stage timeline at a glance 
    •  
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
Real-time tracking from dispatch to done screenshot
 
Drop image or GIF here
 
 
  
 
 
   05  
Secure in-app payments with escrow protection
 
Pay only when the job is done. Funds are held in escrow by Geeb and released to the pro on your approval — cashless, contactless, and protected. Apple Pay, Google Pay, and all major cards supported.
 
     
  •   Funds held in escrow until approval 
  •   Apple Pay, Google Pay, all major cards 
  •   Automatic receipts and invoices 
  •   Refundable on quality disputes 
    •  
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
Secure in-app payments with escrow protection screenshot
 
Drop image or GIF here
 
 
  
 
 
   06  
30-day workmanship guarantee
 
Every booking is backed by our 30-day workmanship guarantee. If something is not right after the job, we make it right at no extra cost — and we follow up to make sure you are happy.
 
     
  •   30-day coverage on all completed work 
  •   Free re-service for qualifying issues 
  •   Dedicated support team for claims 
  •   Follow-up satisfaction check 
    •
